status.offline: Offline - changes will be sent later

credentialsRequired: Both the username or email address and the password are required.
connectCodeRequired: Enter the code shown on the website's devices page.

changesRefused.one: One change could not be saved to your account, so it will not be kept on this device. This usually means whatever it belonged to was deleted on another device.
changesRefused.other: {count} changes could not be saved to your account, so they will not be kept on this device. This usually means whatever they belonged to was deleted on another device.

loggedOutOffline: Signed out on this device, but the server could not be reached, so this device may still be listed on your account.
deviceReturning: Welcome back. This device was signed out of "{name}" before, so it has picked up where it left off rather than being added to your account a second time.

deviceNameTaken.title: That name is already in use
deviceNameTaken.message: "{name}" is another device on your account, and it is signed in right now. If that device is this one, reinstalled, take it over - you keep its history and the old installation is signed out. Otherwise pick a different name, or keep both: two devices are allowed to share a name.

deviceTakenOver: This device is now "{name}", and the installation that held it has been signed out.
deviceNotRenamed: This device was not renamed - the server could not be reached.
